note: WORKSPACE_GENERATED_COPY_V97 in app/app.js is a GENERATED table: it was machine-translated in
one pass at v97 and, until nestly_v465, had no generator in the repo, so the only way to add a
string was to hand-edit 1472 entries of frozen JSON. Exactly one entry ('/month') had been added
that way, and it shows: it sits alone past the end of the sort order. v461's author declined to
hand-patch three more and said the generator's owner should add them; this file plus that script
IS the generator, and this is where the three strings go.
Every entry here is applied on every run and the run is idempotent, so this doubles as the
reviewed ledger of every source string added to the generated table since v97.
Curated overrides for critical labels still belong in WORKSPACE_COPY_V97, which wins over this
table at lookup time (curated ?? generated ?? source).

entries.reason: nestly_v437/v461 made the Reports money card and the dashboard tile name the unit the figure is actually in, so a stamps merchant reads 'Stamps earned' where a points merchant reads 'Points earned'. The points row has been translated since v97; its stamps twin never was, so a zh-CN or ms merchant on a stamps programme read the row in English.
Same row group as 'Stamps earned' — the Reports money card renders all three from loyaltyUnitNounV461(d.loyalty_unit).

2026-08-23 correction flagged during the v462-v466 ruling wave: the v97 machine pass rendered loyalty 'stamp' as 邮票 (a POSTAGE stamp) in four entries, while every string translated since (v437/v461: 赚取印花, 印花已过期) correctly uses 印花. zh-CN merchants read a mixed vocabulary for one concept. Minimal fix: the same string with 邮票 replaced by 印花; the ms strings were already correct (setem) and are restated unchanged because an entry must carry both locales.
